clues: I lived in a generation that had turned far from God.
I was told to build something very large out of gopher wood.
I gathered my family and pairs of every kind of animal.
After the waters receded, a dove brought me an olive leaf.
I was the youngest in my family and kept my father's sheep.
A prophet anointed me king while I was still a boy.
I defeated a giant with a sling and a single stone.
I wrote many psalms and ruled Israel from Jerusalem.
I was hidden in a basket among the reeds as a baby.
I fled to Midian after taking a man's life in Egypt.
I spoke with God at a burning bush on a holy mountain.
I led Israel through the Red Sea and received the Ten Commandments.
I tried to run away from an assignment God gave me.
I boarded a ship heading in the opposite direction of where I was sent.
A great storm threatened the ship until I was thrown overboard.
I spent three days inside a great fish before preaching in Nineveh.
I was set apart from birth by a Nazirite vow.
My strength was a gift, but I often used it recklessly.
I tore a lion apart with my bare hands.
Delilah cut my hair, and my strength left me.
I was an orphan raised by my cousin Mordecai.
I was chosen in a royal search across the kingdom.
I became queen of Persia without revealing my Jewish identity at first.
I risked my life to save my people from Haman's plot.
I was a fisherman on the Sea of Galilee.
Jesus gave me a new name meaning "rock."
I walked on water toward Jesus — until I began to sink.
I denied knowing Jesus three times before the rooster crowed.
I was taken to Babylon as a young exile from Judah.
I refused the king's rich food and ate only vegetables.
I interpreted dreams that baffled the wise men of the empire.
I was thrown into a lions' den but came out unharmed.
I was a fortified city standing in Israel's path.
Two spies were hidden in my walls before the attack.
Israel marched around me once a day for six days.
On the seventh day, my walls fell after seven trumpets and a great shout.
My brothers hated me because of my father's favor and my dreams.
They sold me to traders heading toward Egypt.
I rose from prison by interpreting the ruler's dreams.
I stored grain for seven years and saved Egypt and my family from famine.
I announced a drought that lasted for years.
I was fed by ravens beside a brook called Cherith.
I challenged hundreds of false prophets on Mount Carmel.
I was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind, leaving my cloak for Elisha.
I was built according to precise instructions given on a mountain.
I was overlaid with gold and carried by poles so no one touched me directly.
I held the stone tablets of God's law.
I was carried around Jericho before its walls fell.
